name: com.rowhousesoftware/puzzle-column
title: Puzzle Column
description: Newspaper style puzzles with answers, a PDF and a paste-in snippet.

tools.name: make_puzzle
tools.description: Makes one puzzle with the engine Puzzle Column's daily feeds use: mini5 (Mini crossword), mini7 (Midi crossword), wordsearch (Word search), sudoku (Sudoku), ladder (Word ladder), cryptogram (Cryptogram), maze (Maze). Built by code and checked before it's kept (crossword words cross right, a sudoku has one answer, a maze has one way through). Gives back a picture of the puzzle, the answers as text, a printable PDF (puzzle, then answers), the puzzle as a picture for a newsletter, and an HTML snippet with a small credit link. The same kind, level, date and name always give the same puzzle.

level.description: easy, medium or hard. Defaults to medium.

date.description: The issue date printed on the puzzle, like 2026-12-04. Defaults to today.

newsletter_name.description: The newsletter or paper's name, printed at the top.

tools.name: list_puzzle_types
tools.description: Lists the puzzles Puzzle Column makes, the levels, and what the website's daily feeds add.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Says what Puzzle Column's plans add on the website (a daily puzzle readers play on your own site, your logo, print files), what they cost and where to start. Nothing is bought here.
